position.docs:
**int**: The position to report in steps.

*See also: [Stepper Component](https://esphome.io/components/stepper#stepperreport_position-action)*

report_position.docs: All steppers start out with a target and current position of `0` on boot. However, if you for example want to home a stepper motor, it can be useful to **report** the stepper where it is currently at.

target.docs:
**int**: The target position in steps.

*See also: [Stepper Component](https://esphome.io/components/stepper#stepperset_target-action)*

set_target.docs: To use your stepper motor in [automations](https://esphome.io/automations) or templates, you can use this action to set the target position (in steps). The stepper will always run towards the target position and stop once it has reached the target.

acceleration.docs:
**float**: The acceleration in `steps/s^2` (steps per seconds squared) to use when starting to move. The default is `inf` which means infinite acceleration, so the stepper will try to drive with the full speed immediately. This value is helpful if that first motion of the motor is too jerky for what it's moving. If you make this a small number, it will take the motor a moment to get up to speed.

*See also: [Stepper Component](https://esphome.io/components/stepper#base-stepper-configuration)*

deceleration.docs:
**float**: The same as `acceleration`, but for when the motor is decelerating shortly before reaching the set position. Defaults to `inf` (immediate deceleration).

*See also: [Stepper Component](https://esphome.io/components/stepper#base-stepper-configuration)*

max_speed.docs:
**float**: The maximum speed in `steps/s` (steps per seconds) to drive the stepper at. Note most steppers can't step properly with speeds higher than 250 steps/s.

*See also: [Stepper Component](https://esphome.io/components/stepper#base-stepper-configuration)*
